description: Mark a KB attachment public or private. Every attachment defaults to private on upload. Only a public attachment can ever be offered or sent by the agent's converse tool (email attachment, or a shared file in chat) — a private one is never visible to the model at all, regardless of what a visitor asks for.

is_public.description: True to let the agent attach/send this file; false (default) to keep it private.

name: admin__set_attachment_visibility
